candidate_checks.name: Adaptable, incremental, and explainable NIDS for IoT
candidate_checks.paper_repository_association: Author repository README names the EAAI paper and DOI; author-lab page confirms the publication.
candidate_checks.protocol: Packet-sequence CNN with packet length/inter-arrival/direction/window fields and native packet-data preprocessing; multihead outputs include task-agnostic concatenated evaluation. There is no verified ready-made fixed-vector clean-cache adapter.

cpu_runtime_diagnostic.tabular_forward_error: RuntimeError: Expected 3D (unbatched) or 4D (batched) input to conv2d, but got input of size: [5, 40]
cpu_runtime_diagnostic.interpretation: The exact upstream criterion casts KD to float, detaching that term from autograd. The nonzero KD gradient before conversion is lost; this is an implementation defect, not a measured failure of the BiC algorithm.

fairness_and_adaptation_requirements: Replace packet input/network only with explicit matched-backbone adaptation documentation, not a claim of identical reproduction.
Fix detached KD and test it; no upstream fix was made here.
Account for BiC held-out calibration exemplars within the same replay budget and use only training data for validation.
Specify balanced CE and count the default extra 200 bias-training epochs; verify same clean arrays and task schedule.
candidate_checks.decision: Actual licensed public training code is available, but not protocol-compatible or verified runnable today. BiC is an older general CL baseline used in this 2025 NIDS paper, not a novel 2025 algorithm. Do not silently relabel FTMem as an additional method beyond Replay.

verified_paper.title: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning for Network Intrusion Detection Systems
verified_paper.venue_year: IEEE Open Journal of the Communications Society, 2024, volume 5, pages 6736-6757
verified_paper.input: Section III-B / Table 3: biflows represented by 20 packets x 6 per-packet fields (size, direction, TCP window, inter-arrival time, TTL, TCP flags), zero-padding and Min-Max scaling; not the present tabular flow features.
verified_paper.protocol: Multiclass benign plus attacks. Old-class pretraining precedes adaptation episodes with support and query samples from both old and new classes. Section IV-B evaluates 100 episodes with 10 support and 5 query examples per class; 12 total classes for CSE-CIC-IDS2018 and 10 for IoT-NID. This is not automatically the Section21 full-data sequential-task protocol.
verified_paper.implementation_statement: Section IV implementation details cite adapted learn2learn, MatchingNet source and LibFewShot RFS; no matching author-released repository link was identified in the inspected paper body. The LibFewShot GitHub link lower on the fulltext hosting page belongs to a cited paper, not this NIDS implementation.
